scope.action: Programmatic node-move preview through the same editing state used by pointer handlers; data-only activity/preview probes and resize/cancel correctness.
scope.flushMs: performance.now from preview call through Svelte tick, actual DOM style assertion and layout read.
scope.frameIntervalMs: Consecutive requestAnimationFrame callback timestamps during sustained preview updates; compositor paint and input delivery are not measured.
scope.activityMs: One sample per tier, after replacement-array allocation; includes adapter classification and mounted DOM flush.

test: mounted canvas spatial queries, retained previews, presentation and navigation
